web/vendor/kokoro.web.js is kokoro-js 1.2.1's dist/kokoro.web.js, copied verbatim
(npm kokoro-js@1.2.1). It is used only by Film's "Voices in the video" (web/film/voices.mjs).

It bundles:
- kokoro-js 1.2.1 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro/tree/main/kokoro.js
- @huggingface/transformers 3.5.1 — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js
- onnxruntime-web (JavaScript) — MIT — https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
- phonemizer (npm) — Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/xenova/phonemizer.js — which embeds
  eSpeak NG compiled to WebAssembly — GPL-3.0-or-later — https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng

Fetched at run time, never stored in this repository:
- the Kokoro-82M v1.0 model and voices (onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX,
  Apache-2.0) from huggingface.co
- onnxruntime-web's wasm from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@huggingface/transformers@3.5.1/dist/

Every URL in the bundle was read before shipping it: model files, the wasm, and
documentation links. No analytics, beacon or POST. tests/face.test.mjs scans it
with the other vendored files.
